City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
NOVEMBER 13, 2012
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Holloway, Klinakis, Argudo, House, and Lewis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION TO THE SCHOLARSHIP RECEPIENTS
PRESENTATION OF CITY TILE TO RETIRING DEPUTY SCOTT HENSEL
PRESENTATION TO COUNCIL ON THE ONTARIO AIRPORT
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE RETURN OF LOCAL CONTROL OVER ONTARIO AIRPORT (Mayor Holloway)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-1 Ontario_Airport-Sample_Support_Resolution
E-3
UPDATE ON THE CITY'S SPECIAL EVENTS AND DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER FROM THE OLD TOWN PUENTE ASSOCIATION
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review and discuss this report and provide direction to staff regarding the request from the Old Town Puente Association. Should the Council wish to move forward with a fee waiver, a resolution will be brought to the Council for consideration at its November 27th City Council meeting.
E-3 Upcoming Events Final Report
E-3 Letter to the Association_Attachment A
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF AUGUST 14, 2012 AND AUGUST 28, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of August 14, 2012 and August 28, 2012.
08-14-12 CC Minutes
08-28-12 CC Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING CHANGING THE HOURS OF THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING (Mayor Pro Tem Klinakis)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
C-1 Admin Staff Report-City Council Meeting Hours
C-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING FINANCING STRATEGIES
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
C-2 Finance Staff Report - Financing Strategies
C-2 Finance Staff Report - Financing Strategies (Attachment A-Presentation)
C-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING CITY COUNCIL POLICY CC - 4.1, SAFETY PROGRAM AND SAFETY MANUAL
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution approving City Council Policy CC - 4.1, Safety Program.
C-3 Admin Staff Report - Safety Program Policy
C-3 Admin Staff Report - Safety Program Policy (Attachment A -Resolution)
C-3 Admin Staff Report - Safety Program Policy (Exhibit A - Policy)
C-3 Admin Staff Report - Safety Program Policy (Exhibit B - Safety Manual)
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1329 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013
The City Council adopted Resolution No. 12-5048 approving Warrant Register No. 1329.
D-1 warrant register
D-2
APPROVAL OF TRAFFIC SIGNAL SYNCHRONIZATON AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
The City Council approved Agreement No. 12-1097 with the County of Los Angeles for the Traffic Signal Synchronization Program and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement.
D-2 Traffic Signal Synchron Staff Report
D-2 TSSP Co-Op Agreement La Puente 2012 Attach A
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AGREEMENT WITH ROSS & CASSO FOR ATTORNEY AND RELATED LEGAL SERVICES
The City Council approved Legal Services Agreement No. 12-1098 between the City and Ross & Casso for City Attorney and General Counsel Services.
D-3_Staff_Report_Ross_Casso_Legal_Services_Agreement
D-3 City Attorney Agreement Ross & Casso Attach A
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-2
REVIEW, DISCUSSION, AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE APRIL 2012 ELECTION COSTS AND THE APRIL 2014 ELECTION (Mayor Holloway)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF AUGUST 14, 2012, AND AUGUST 28, 2012
The Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of August 14, 2012 and August 28, 2012.
08-14-12 SA Minutes
08-28-12 SA Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE WARRANT REGISTERS FOR THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION FOR NOVEMBER 13, 2012
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council, acting as the Successor Agency of the Community Development Commission, adopt a Resolution approving the Successor Agency Warrant Register No. 4 for November 13, 2012.
SA D-1 Warrant Register #4 - Resolution
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AGREEMENT WITH ROSS & CASSO FOR ATTORNEY AND RELATED LEGAL SERVICES
The Successor Agency approved Legal Services Agreement No. 12-1098 between the Successor Agency and Ross & Casso for General Counsel Services.
SA D-2 Staff_Report_Ross_Casso_Legal_Services_Agreement
SA D-2 City Attorney Agreement Ross & Casso Attach A
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY - None.
ADJOURN THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY, RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL
F.
CLOSED SESSION - None.
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection at the City Clerk Department at City Hall located at 15900 E Main Street and the Reference Desk at the Library located at 15920 E. Central during normal business hours. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City?s website at http://www.lapuente.org
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk?s Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION

Dated this 8th day of November, 2012.
